rooms.name: Old Svalich Road
rooms.desc: The muddy road is pitted with still, black pools. Huge old pines crowd both verges, their upper limbs lost in the fog.
rooms.dm: On foot the party reaches the Gates of Barovia (B) after 5 hours; in Vistani wagons, half that. Roll for random encounters as usual. The way back east is the Mists.

objects.label: The Mists
objects.desc: A wall of grey fog stands across the road the way you came. A few steps in, the trees vanish.

objects.label: The Mists: a creature starting its turn in the fog makes a DC 20 Con save or gains a level of exhaustion (not removable while in the fog); the area is heavily obscured; whoever walks into it is turned around and comes out in Barovia again.
Standing pools in and beside the road: difficult terrain.
West: the road runs on to the Gates of Barovia (B).
